label: model evaluation
definition: A requirement for providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk to perform model evaluation using standardised protocols and tools reflecting the state of the art, including adversarial testing.
source_quote: perform model evaluation in accordance with standardised protocols and tools reflecting the state of the art, including conducting and documenting adversarial testing of the model

label: assess and mitigate possible systemic risks
definition: A requirement for providers to assess and mitigate possible systemic risks at Union level that may stem from the development, placing on the market, or use of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk.
source_quote: assess and mitigate possible systemic risks at Union level, including their sources, that may stem from the development, the placing on the market, or the use of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk

label: keep track of, document, and report serious incidents
definition: A requirement for providers to keep track of, document, and report relevant information about serious incidents and possible corrective measures to the AI Office and national competent authorities without undue delay.
source_quote: keep track of, document, and report, without undue delay, to the AI Office and, as appropriate, to national competent authorities, relevant information about serious incidents and possible corrective measures to address them

label: adequate level of cybersecurity protection
definition: A requirement for providers to ensure an adequate level of cybersecurity protection for the general-purpose AI model with systemic risk and its physical infrastructure.
source_quote: ensure an adequate level of cybersecurity protection for the general-purpose AI model with systemic risk and the physical infrastructure of the model

label: rely on codes of practice to demonstrate compliance
definition: An obligation allowing providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk to rely on codes of practice within the meaning of Article 56 to demonstrate compliance with obligations set out in paragraph 1 until a harmonised standard is published.
source_quote: Providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk may rely on codes of practice within the meaning of Article 56 to demonstrate compliance with the obligations set out in paragraph 1 of this Article

term: Presumption of Conformity via Harmonised Standards
label: compliance grants presumption of conformity
definition: An obligation stating that compliance with European harmonised standards grants providers the presumption of conformity to the extent that those standards cover the obligations.
source_quote: Compliance with European harmonised standards grants providers the presumption of conformity to the extent that those standards cover those obligations

label: demonstrate alternative adequate means of compliance
definition: An obligation for providers who do not adhere to an approved code of practice or comply with a European harmonised standard to demonstrate alternative adequate means of compliance for assessment by the Commission.
source_quote: Providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risks who do not adhere to an approved code of practice or do not comply with a European harmonised standard shall demonstrate alternative adequate means of compliance for assessment by the Commission

label: treat information in accordance with confidentiality obligations
definition: An obligation requiring that any information or documentation obtained pursuant to this Article, including trade secrets, shall be treated in accordance with the confidentiality obligations set out in Article 78.
source_quote: Any information or documentation obtained pursuant to this Article, including trade secrets, shall be treated in accordance with the confidentiality obligations set out in Article 78
